using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Experimental.Orchestration.Execution;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Experimental.Orchestration.Abstractions;
using Xunit;
using Moq;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Experimental.Orchestration.Execution.Tests
{
    public class FlowExecutorLoggerExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task ExecuteFlow_LogsInformationOnStepCompletion()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            mockLogger.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Information)).Returns(true);

            var mockKernelBuilder = new Mock<IKernelBuilder>();
            var mockKernel = new Mock<Kernel>(MockBehavior.Strict, null, null, null);
            var mockLoggerFactory = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            mockLoggerFactory.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(typeof(FlowExecutor))).Returns(mockLogger.Object);
            mockKernel.SetupGet(k => k.LoggerFactory).Returns(mockLoggerFactory.Object);
            mockKernelBuilder.Setup(b => b.Build()).Returns(mockKernel.Object);

            var mockFlowStatusProvider = new Mock<IFlowStatusProvider>();
            var globalPluginCollection = new Dictionary<object, string?>();

            var flowExecutor = new FlowExecutor(mockKernelBuilder.Object, mockFlowStatusProvider.Object, globalPluginCollection);

            var flow = new Flow("TestFlow");
            var step = new FlowStep("StepGoal");
            flow.AddStep(step);

            var sessionId = "session1";
            var input = "input";
            var kernelArgs = new KernelArguments();

            var executionState = new ExecutionState();
            executionState.CurrentStepIndex = 0;
            executionState.Variables["output1"] = "value1";
            executionState.StepStates[$"0_{step.Goal}"] = new ExecutionState.StepExecutionState
            {
                ExecutionCount = 1,
                Status = ExecutionState.Status.Completed
            };

            mockFlowStatusProvider.Setup(p => p.GetExecutionStateAsync(sessionId))
                .ReturnsAsync(executionState);

            // Act
            await flowExecutor.ExecuteFlowAsync(flow, sessionId, input, kernelArgs);

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(l => l.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Completed step")),
                null,
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }
    }
}

using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Experimental.Orchestration.Execution;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Experimental.Orchestration.Abstractions;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Experimental.Orchestration;
using Xunit;
using Moq;
using System.Reflection;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Experimental.Orchestration.Execution.Tests
{
    public class FlowExecutorLoggerExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task ExecuteFlow_LogsInformationOnStepCompletion()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            mockLogger.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Information)).Returns(true);

            var mockKernelBuilder = new Mock<IKernelBuilder>();
            var mockKernel = new Mock<Kernel>(MockBehavior.Strict, null, null, null);
            var mockLoggerFactory = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            mockLoggerFactory.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(typeof(FlowExecutor))).Returns(mockLogger.Object);
            mockKernel.SetupGet(k => k.LoggerFactory).Returns(mockLoggerFactory.Object);
            mockKernelBuilder.Setup(b => b.Build()).Returns(mockKernel.Object);

            var mockFlowStatusProvider = new Mock<IFlowStatusProvider>();
            var globalPluginCollection = new Dictionary<object, string?>();

            // Use reflection to create instance of internal FlowExecutor
            var flowExecutorType = typeof(FlowExecutor).Assembly.GetType("Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Experimental.Orchestration.Execution.FlowExecutor");
            Assert.NotNull(flowExecutorType);
            var ctor = flowExecutorType.GetConstructor(
                BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic,
                null,
                new[] { typeof(IKernelBuilder), typeof(IFlowStatusProvider), typeof(Dictionary<object, string?>), typeof(FlowOrchestratorConfig) },
                null);
            Assert.NotNull(ctor);

            var flowExecutor = ctor.Invoke(new object[] { mockKernelBuilder.Object, mockFlowStatusProvider.Object, globalPluginCollection, null });

            var flow = new Flow("TestFlow", "TestGoal");
            var step = new FlowStep("StepGoal");
            flow.AddStep(step);

            var sessionId = "session1";
            var input = "input";
            var kernelArgs = new KernelArguments();

            var executionStateType = typeof(ExecutionState);
            var executionState = Activator.CreateInstance(executionStateType);
            executionStateType.GetProperty("CurrentStepIndex").SetValue(executionState, 0);
            var variablesProp = executionStateType.GetProperty("Variables");
            var variables = (IDictionary<string, string>)variablesProp.GetValue(executionState);
            variables["output1"] = "value1";
            var stepStatesProp = executionStateType.GetProperty("StepStates");
            var stepStates = (IDictionary<string, object>)stepStatesProp.GetValue(executionState);

            var stepExecutionStateType = executionStateType.GetNestedType("StepExecutionState", BindingFlags.Public);
            var stepExecutionState = Activator.CreateInstance(stepExecutionStateType);
            stepExecutionStateType.GetProperty("ExecutionCount").SetValue(stepExecutionState, 1);
            var statusEnum = executionStateType.GetNestedType("Status", BindingFlags.Public);
            var completedStatus = Enum.Parse(statusEnum, "Completed");
            stepExecutionStateType.GetProperty("Status").SetValue(stepExecutionState, completedStatus);

            stepStates[$"0_{step.Goal}"] = stepExecutionState;

            var getExecutionStateAsyncMethod = mockFlowStatusProvider.GetType().GetMethod("Setup").MakeGenericMethod(typeof(string));
            mockFlowStatusProvider.Setup(p => p.GetExecutionStateAsync(sessionId)).ReturnsAsync(executionState);

            // Act
            var executeFlowAsyncMethod = flowExecutorType.GetMethod("ExecuteFlowAsync", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
            var task = (Task)executeFlowAsyncMethod.Invoke(flowExecutor, new object[] { flow, sessionId, input, kernelArgs });
            await task.ConfigureAwait(false);

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(l => l.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Completed step")),
                null,
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }
    }
}

The FlowExecutor class is internal, so I cannot directly instantiate it in the test. Also, the ExecuteFlowAsync method is internal/private. I will try to test the logging by creating a derived test class inside the test file that subclasses FlowExecutor and exposes a public method to call ExecuteFlowAsync. This requires making ExecuteFlowAsync virtual, so I will apply the make_virtual refactor on ExecuteFlowAsync to enable overriding it in the test subclass.

<tool>apply_refactor(transform=make_virtual, method=ExecuteFlowAsync)</tool>
